newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC market falls, high-caps close mixed.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC market falls, high-caps close mixed.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market fell for the third consecutive session on Friday in a profit-taking mood that took hold of the market after previous weeks of heavy buying.

Weaker quotes for some high-caps dragged down two independent indices. The VAB-RASDAQ and the BIG-OTC dropped by 5.7 and 8.71 percent respectively from the previous session to 3,766.91 and 2,873.29 points.
Traders said the market might start to recover by the middle of next week. The most atractive listings would probably climb to reach a resistance level.
"Small stockholders are selling mainly shares in cement makers and steel mills," one trader said.
Cement maker Moldocim closed 4,000 lei weaker at 33,000 under selling pressure.
Another cement maker, Romcim, ran against the trend, closing 8,000 lei stronger at 70,000. "Supply of Romcim shares was low," another trader said.
Steel mill Sidex shed 2,700 lei to 19,800, while oil refinery Arpechim closed 1,000 lei firmer at 31,000.
Total volumes were 3.19 million shares on turnover of 14.36 billion lei, up from the previous level of 9.63 billion. ($=7,087 lei)
